The background is blurred, suggesting an indoor setting.

The boundary between the bandage and the skin is slightly soft and lacks the crisp shadowing expected from a physical object adhering to a curved surface. It feels slightly 'painted on' rather than physically attached.

The only non-present checkpoint (protective strips) is logically excluded because the item is in use. The bandage itself blends slightly too softly into the skin, lacking precise edge definition and realistic contact shadows, resulting in a moderate deduction in artifact score.
